mode: real Chromium IndexedDB in an isolated localhost browser context; Chrome legacy storage adapter mocked; abort/quota/open/version faults explicitly injected

outcomes.name: Automatic schema creation and real indexes
Legacy import commits before cleanup and preserves tied order
Reopen and repeated initialization preserve current DB over stale legacy
Concurrent stale legacy snapshot cannot overwrite a newer committed write
Actual migration transaction abort preserves legacy and supports retry
Quota exception aborts a multi-key write without clearing existing records
Open failure is reported without legacy cleanup or fallback
Real blocked upgrade times out and late success releases its connection
Versionchange closes the live connection and unknown versions remain intact
Private mode makes zero IndexedDB and legacy calls
History retention caps at 200 with unresolved work and stable ties first
Job management enforces count bytes TTL and lazy maintenance
Malformed legacy is quarantined without persisting private rows or pruning bindings
Corrupted current DB row rejects reads without clearing the row
Legacy cleanup failure is visible and retry preserves newer DB writes
Legacy read failure leaves no marker and a later retry can migrate
Duplicate legacy IDs are retained in recovery instead of silently overwritten
Missing migration marker in a populated DB rejects without reimport or deletion
Live migration marker corruption blocks reads writes status and due maintenance
